entity.name: EmbeddedOS Research Foundation
entity.description: EmbeddedOS Research Foundation is a US 501(c)(3) public charity (EIN: 41-4821627) dedicated to open-source embedded operating system security. We develop and maintain eos RTOS, a formally verified MIT-licensed real-time operating system kernel for ARM Cortex-M and RISC-V microcontrollers used in critical infrastructure including medical devices, industrial control systems, and emergency communications equipment. We are a Linux Foundation member organization with prior funding from NLnet Foundation (EUR 150,000, NGI0 Entrust, 2024).

projects.name: eos RTOS
projects.description: eos is a formally verified MIT-licensed real-time operating system kernel for ARM Cortex-M and RISC-V RV32IM microcontrollers. At ~15.8 KB flash, 84 board configs, 5 formally verified security invariants. The FVRTOS project delivers the first machine-checked formally verified open-source RTOS kernel. Prior funding: NLnet Foundation NGI0 Entrust EUR 150,000 (2024). License: MIT.
